groups.operation: Unpack an object member with a nested object format through json_unpack and unpack_object.
groups.condition: The member, such as data in {"data":42}, has the wrong type.
groups.capability: Pass the member key to the nested object type guard and expose its diagnostic through an error sink.
groups.consequence: The fixed {s?o} format accepts the value through o, so the keyed object diagnostic is not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same keyed nested object validation.

groups.operation: Unpack an object member with a nested array format through unpack_array.
groups.condition: The member, such as data in {"data":42}, has the wrong type.
groups.capability: Pass the member key as parent_key to the array type guard and expose its diagnostic.
groups.consequence: The member uses o; the only [o!] call is for a root array, so the keyed array diagnostic is not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same keyed nested array validation.

groups.operation: Unpack an object member using the s string value format.
groups.condition: The member, such as data in {"data":42}, is not a string.
groups.capability: Run the s value type guard with the member key and expose its diagnostic.
groups.consequence: The fixed {s?o} format uses s for the key and o for the value, so the keyed string diagnostic is not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same keyed s value validation.
